messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: release/2026-03-15/runtime-tune-3f8a (canary 5%)
Jamie: seeing a pager for 5xx/timeouts from synthetic checks, p95/p99 spiking. paging oncall.
sre-bot: ALERT: incidents:service-timeouts high - error-rate 7.9% (5m), p95 1.8s, p99 3.4s, upstream gateway timeout spike.
Jamie: @Alex you're on call for runtime today, can you take a look? Canary deployed ~2m ago.
Alex: ack. I’m tailing logs now. grabbing a few traces.
Kevin: multiple customers reporting socket timeout errors in EU region. Support seeing increased CSAT tickets.
Maria: looking at routing — nothing changed at LB. Canary only on a subset of pods.
Alex: logs show a lot of `Connection reset by peer` and `upstream request timeout` from the proxy layer. Also seeing many kept-alive sockets moved to CLOSE_WAIT.
Jamie: can we roll the canary back immediately? Impact looks high. 
Alex: +1 rollback. I’ll trigger.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: release/2026-03-15/runtime-tune-3f8a -> rolling back canary to release/2026-03-08 (in progress)
Alex: quick note: the change was to socket keepalive and connection pool sizing (lowered max idle time to 10s). Hypothesis: aggressive keepalive caused upstream proxies to close sockets earlier, creating spikes under burst traffic.
Jamie: if rollback confirms, we should mark incident as deploy-induced and capture inc-triage. Notify customers in impacted list.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Canary reverted. All canary pods replaced.
Ops: confirm canary metrics returning to baseline?
Alex: running `curl -sS https://canary-metric.internal/summary | jq .` output: before rollback error_rate=7.9, p95=1.8, p99=3.4; after rollback (90s) error_rate=0.6, p95=0.12, p99=0.28. Looks like stabilization.
Jamie: good. Thanks. Keep the page open for 30m observation. Maria, can you open a postmortem ticket and tag runtime + infra?
Maria: will do. Also adding a mitigation checklist: 1) revert keepalive change in config repo 2) add automated canary abort if p95 > 500ms within first 5m 3) add detailed alert at proxy for CLOSE_WAIT growth.
Kevin: frontline note: told customers a rollback is in progress; will follow up with support template.
Alex: next steps for root cause: reproduce locally with stress test to the exact keepalive/pool settings. I’ll instrument more socket metrics (idle sockets, CLOSE_WAIT) and add a chart.
Jamie: leaving oncall to Alex for now. If anything spikes, escalate to SEV. Closing note: deploy-induced timeout regression -> immediate rollback mitigated customer impact.
sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: transition to monitoring-only. Duration: ~15m; impacted: partial EU region; mitigation: rollback; owner: Alex.
Jamie: closing thread once we have the postmortem link. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
